messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
I don’t have a tool that can pull a holiday calendar directly, but here’s a complete list of the Canadian public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. These are the dates that will give you a three‑day (or occasionally four‑day) break when the holiday falls on a weekday.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Result |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | 3‑day weekend (Dec 30‑Jan 1) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Feb 18‑Feb 20) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | 3‑day weekend (Apr 7‑9) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | 3‑day weekend (May 20‑22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Tue | 3‑day weekend (Jul 1‑3) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Sep 2‑4) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Oct 7‑9) |
| Remembrance Day (most provinces) | Nov 11 | Thu | 4‑day weekend (Nov 10‑13) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Dec 23‑25) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | 3‑day weekend (Dec 24‑26) |

### Quick Take‑away

- **January**: New Year’s Day gives you a long weekend even though it falls on a Sunday.
- **February**: Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario creates a long weekend.
- **April**: Good Friday is a Friday, so you get a long weekend.
- **May**: Victoria Day is a Monday, giving you a long weekend.
- **July**: Canada Day is a Tuesday, so you get a long weekend.
- **September**: Labour Day is a Monday, giving you a long weekend.
- **October**: Thanksgiving is a Monday, giving you a long weekend.
- **November**: Remembrance Day is a Thursday in most provinces, so you get a four‑day weekend (Thu‑Mon).
- **December**: Christmas Day is a Monday, and Boxing Day is a Tuesday, so you get two consecutive long weekends.

These are the holidays that will give you the most “free days” in 2023. If you’re planning trips around these dates, you’ll have plenty of time to enjoy a short getaway without taking extra vacation days.
